To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the LIFE programme has a strong potential to contribute to the WFD implementation, but it has not yet fully exploited this potential; (2) the LIFE programme is not a panacea, but a useful instrument for policy makers to implement the WFD; (3) the LIFE programme should be used more strategically to support the WFD implementation; (4) the LIFE programme could be more effectively used if there was a better coordination between the LIFE and the research programme.
